open_points.subject: Customer revision on erasure
open_points.text:
An erasure does not move it: it removes the revision and the
  last-changed instant with every other fact but the identity, and records
  the erased mark with its own instant (M04, A04 rule 1; owner, 2026-11-24).
open_points.question: Does an accepted customer erasure first advance the revision as required for every accepted change of a Customer's own facts, or is erasure an exception that removes the revision without advancing it?
options: Erasure advances the revision and last-changed instant before producing the erased state
Erasure is exempt from the accepted-change rule and atomically removes the revision and last-changed instant without advancing either
open_points.default_guess: Treat the specific erasure sentence as an exception: remove the revision and last-changed instant without advancing them, and qualify the general accepted-change rule accordingly.

witness.initial: A live Customer has revision 3 and a last-changed instant.
events: The owner successfully invokes erase a customer's contact data.
outcomes: Because erasure is an accepted change of the Customer's own facts, its revision becomes 4 and its last-changed instant moves.
Because erasure does not move the pair, revision 3 and the last-changed instant are removed and only the identity and erased mark with its instant remain.
witness.observer: The persistence and model-contract implementers see different post-erasure Customer facts.

open_points.subject: Customer created instant after erasure
open_points.text:
An erasure does not move it: it removes the revision and the
  last-changed instant with every other fact but the identity, and records
  the erased mark with its own instant (M04, A04 rule 1; owner, 2026-11-24).
open_points.question: Does an erased Customer retain its created instant because every Customer carries it, or is that instant removed as one of every other fact but the identity?
options: Retain the Customer's created instant after erasure
Remove the created instant and retain only identity plus the erased mark and its instant
open_points.default_guess: Remove the created instant, following the explicit terminal-erasure rule, and qualify the earlier statement so only a non-erased Customer carries its created instant.

witness.initial: A live Customer has identity C1 and created instant T1.
events: The owner erases C1's contact data at T2.
outcomes: C1 retains created instant T1 because a Customer carries the instant it was created.
C1 loses T1 because erasure removes every fact except identity and the erased mark with its own instant T2.
witness.observer: A later model serializer, backup reader, or owner-facing read that includes tombstone metadata sees the difference.

open_points.subject: Closed form of an erased Customer
open_points.text:
An erasure does not move it: it removes the revision and the
  last-changed instant with every other fact but the identity, and records
  the erased mark with its own instant (M04, A04 rule 1; owner, 2026-11-24).
open_points.question: What closed runtime-model form represents the Customer before and after erasure?
options: One Customer entity whose live fields become absent and whose erased marker or erased instant becomes present
A discriminated union with separate live-Customer and erased-Customer variants
A live Customer entity replaced by a separate erased-customer tombstone entity under the same identity
open_points.default_guess: Use one Customer entity with nullable live fields and an `erased_at` fact whose presence marks erasure.

open_points.subject: Reads of the Customer erasure instant
open_points.text:
records
  the erased mark with its own instant
open_points.question: Which product actions, if any, return the newly recorded erasure instant?
options: `read a customer` returns the erased mark and its instant; `list customers` returns only the erased mark
Both `read a customer` and `list customers` return the erased instant
Neither action returns the instant; it is persistence-only lifecycle metadata
open_points.default_guess: Return it from `read a customer` but not from `list customers`.

witness.initial: Customer C1 has been erased and its erased mark records instant T2.
outcomes: The read or list exposes T2 with the erased marker.
The same action exposes only that C1 is erased and never exposes T2.
witness.observer: The owner and clients implementing the customer read or list contract see different response facts.
